title: Returns specific decline codes for BLIK payment failures
summary: Replaces the generic_decline decline code with code_invalid, code_expired, insufficient_funds, customer_declined, payment_limit_exceeded, and partner_generic_decline for applicable BLIK payment failures. Integrations with strict decline-code handling must accept code_invalid, code_expired, insufficient_funds, customer_declined, payment_limit_exceeded, and partner_generic_decline. Previously, API versions before Endive received generic_decline.
migrationNotes: You now receive specific decline codes for applicable BLIK payment failures. Update your error handling to support code_invalid, code_expired, insufficient_funds, customer_declined, payment_limit_exceeded, and partner_generic_decline. For details about these decline codes, see decline codes.
